item.title: Staff at the CDC in Atlanta remember victim of shooting a year ago as RFK jr. attends
item.description: It's been a year since a gunman opened fire on the CDC and killed a security guard. RFK Jr. visited the CDC today to remember the victim.
item.content:encoded: It's been a year since a gunman opened fire on the CDC and killed a security guard. RFK Jr. visited the CDC today to remember the victim.

item.title: Another court blocks White House ballroom work, teeing up a Supreme Court review
item.description: A federal appeals court says above-ground construction cannot continue without approval from Congress, siding with historic preservation advocates.

item.title: Amid cost of living stress, many parents are supporting children well into adulthood
item.description: Polls show most Americans think young adults today have it harder financially than past generations. A majority of parents help their grown children with expenses, even if it hurts their own finances.

item.title: When tragedy strikes, America's wildland firefighters ask, was it 'somebody that we loved?'
item.description: Deaths and close calls while fighting wildfires have strained an already on-edge workforce. They've also raised questions about policies and priorities amid an intense wildfire season.

item.description: For StoryCorps, we hear a conversation with an ice cream truck driver who holds the world record for the longest career as an ice cream distributor.

item.title: Investigation into Mississippi teen's death continues as threats circulate online
item.description: It's been a month since the body of Nolan Wells was found on a Mississippi island. The death of the Black teenager remains under investigation as speculations and threats circulate online.

item.title: Trump signs new orders targeting birthright citizenship, weeks after Supreme Court ruling
item.description: President Trump is once again attempting to put restrictions on who is automatically guaranteed citizenship after being born in the U.S., just weeks after the Supreme Court struck down his attempt to end birthright citizenship.

item.title: In the wake of Spokane wildfires, preparedness experts think it could've been worse
item.description: As emergency responders in Spokane take stock of the damages from devastating wildfires, there's a prevailing sense that this disaster could have been far worse.
